title: Conformal metric and loop convergence of FK maps below four
exact_target: For each fixed FK weight $0<q<4$, do canonical flag-triangulation conformal embeddings of spherical n-edge FK maps admit deterministic distance rescalings $a_n\to 0$ so that the area measure, the entire distance graph and every macroscopic nested loop converge jointly, through all n, to the corresponding Liouville quantum sphere and CLE decoration? Require vanishing spherical flag mesh and the stated conditional independence of the loop decoration and embedded marked quantum surface.
